# Konnections IMAG

> Integrated PR, crisis communications and investor relations consultancy in Hyderabad, India. 15+ years advising brands, 500+ brands represented, 30+ industry verticals.

## Practice areas

- [Public Relations & Reputation Management](https://www.konnectionsimag.com/services/public-relations): media relations, brand positioning and perception audits.
- [Crisis Management & Communications](https://www.konnectionsimag.com/services/crisis-management): crisis planning, 24/7 response, media training and reputation recovery.
- [Financial Communications & Investor Relations](https://www.konnectionsimag.com/services/financial-communications): investor relations, earnings communication, analyst relations and disclosure policy.
- [Digital Media & Social Strategy](https://www.konnectionsimag.com/services/digital-media): social strategy, content, influencer programmes and digital news distribution.
- [Corporate Communications](https://www.konnectionsimag.com/services/corporate-communications): internal and executive communications, CSR communication and thought leadership.
- [Specialised Services & Consulting](https://www.konnectionsimag.com/services/specialized-services): media training, market research, communication audits and B2B communications.
